replies.re: Promo v6, more production value (via builder)
replies.body: Not made yet. My daily run is set to stay lean, and v5's production tools (phone frame, zooms, music mix) were never saved to the repo, so v6 means rebuilding them from scratch. I'd rather not rush a version that looks worse than v5. Once the Builder saves those scripts (or you OK a long run), I'll make v6 with the four plain-words points, under 45 seconds, real footage only.

Mobile app: good for marketing. Reels already look like a phone app, and 'download on the App Store' is an easier ask than a website link (TikTok links aren't clickable anyway). Until it launches, reels keep saying 'coming soon, follow for launch day'.
